findings.requirement: tech.md: Data location, snapshots, and freezes (resolve repo root at run time)
findings.summary: With DATA_DIR unset, `make hello` in the worktree resolves to <worktree>/.local-data/worktrees/.../.local-data/data (git rev-parse --show-toplevel returns the worktree path). This matches tech.md's run-time-resolution wording and is irrelevant to this task; with DATA_DIR exported (Kiro Web) it prints the shared main-repo .local-data/data. Later: consider resolving via git --git-common-dir so worktrees share one data dir.

findings.requirement: tech.md: fallback when DATA_DIR is unset, missing, or not writable
findings.summary: Pre-existing `export DATA_DIR ?=` only covers unset, not missing or non-writable, and does not create the folder. Out of scope for the hello target; hello correctly relies on the existing fallback.
